prompt: Build an enterprise-grade Order Processing and Inventory Management System in C# structured into three decoupled layers: (1) RESTful API Endpoint Router parsing incoming purchase orders, (2) Inventory Reservation Engine handling concurrency locks to prevent race conditions during stock depletion, and (3) Payment Gateway Integration Subsystem implementing circuit breaker patterns for third-party transaction timeouts.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Router Score: 0-5 (Evaluates input parsing and request routing)
Module 2 Inventory Score: 0-5 (Evaluates thread-safe concurrency locking and stock validation)
Module 3 Payment Score: 0-5 (Evaluates circuit breaker state machine and timeout management)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates transactional consistency across modules)
